top_violation_types.title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures (26 TAC §747.5003(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Emergency preparedness plan was unavailable to review

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was no admission information available for children in care.

top_violation_types.title: Must Have at Least One 3A-40BC Dry Chemical Fire Extinguisher or Fire Extinguisher Approved by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §747.5103)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation was observed to have a fire extinguisher 1A-10 BC instead of the required 3A-40BC fire extinguisher.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Instructions for Contacting Licensing Office/Online and TX Abuse & Neglect Hotline (26 TAC §747.501(11))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have the required emergency preparedness plan.

top_violation_types.title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not conduct a fire drill for the month of August.

top_violation_types.title: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns (26 TAC §746.3301(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation is serving a variety of snacks to children that do not have any nutritional value, and that exceed the allowed amount of sugar per the food program guidelines.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(12))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 10 children were missing special care needs information in their admission paperwork.

top_violation_types.title: Update Admission Information - Procedure (26 TAC §746.609(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The admission forms have not been updated to reflect changes made to minimum standards.
